newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra sale on track-Australia govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra sale on track-Australia govt.

text.p: Australian Communications Minister Richard Alston said on Friday that Telecoms carrier Telstra Corp's half-year results showed it was well placed for partial privatisation before the end of calendar 1997.
"I think the company is very well placed for privatisation," Alston told reporters.

Earlier on Friday, Telstra reported a 16.1 percent jump in net profit before abnormal items to A$1.40 billion for the six months to December 31, while net profit after abnormals fell to A$742 million from A$1.205 billion previously.
"I don't think it affects the timing," Alston said. "We're still hopeful that (the sale) will occur before the end of the calendar year."
He also said Telstra's interim dividend of A$625 million was in line with government expectations. Canberra last year moved to sell one-third of Telstra for a projected A$8.0 billion.
